u2-empirical-rule.alt: Normal density curve for egg weights with mean 58 grams and standard deviation 4 grams, axis marked from 46 to 70 grams. Brackets show that about 68% of weights fall within 1 standard deviation (54 to 62 g), about 95% within 2 (50 to 66 g) and about 99.7% within 3 (46 to 70 g).
